Important Dates for Graduate Admissions
UMass Dartmouth makes admissions decisions for graduate students on a rolling basis. Programs may close once they reach capacity.
Fall semester
For fall applicants, the date for priority consideration for university assistantships or fellowships is January 15.
Application closing dates:
Psychology: Clinical: January 15, applications submitted after the deadline will be reviewed as space permits, until April 1
Law: June 30
International application: July 15
Domestic application: Rolling
Spring semester
For spring applicants, the date for priority consideration for university assistantships or fellowships is October 1.
Application closing dates:
International application: December 15
Domestic application: Rolling
Summer semester
Domestic application: Rolling
Note: International students may only apply for fall or spring.
Only full-time, degree-seeking students are eligible for university assistantships or fellowships.
